Choose the material for the surface

The decorative version is intended for mirrors, bathtub exterior panels and the outside of closed WC lids. The floor-grip version is a separate material specification for wet floor applications. The illustrations and dimensions stay the same. Do not place decorative stickers on walking surfaces.

Placement and care

Keep the central mirror view, drains, hinges and flush controls clear. Final surface compatibility, cleaning, application and removal instructions will follow material testing. Do not apply to toilet seating surfaces or bowl interiors.
